AppConfig.title: AppConfig
AppConfig.description: Configuration settings for GuberStudio kiosk browser, including target link synchronized across all client devices.

targetUrl.description: The current URL loaded by all client devices in the kiosk webview.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the link was last updated.

updatedBy.description: Identifier of the admin who updated the link.

/app_config/{configId}.description: Stores app-wide settings including the active kiosk target link.
